title: Versus win modes
description: The win modes of one versus map (GH-976, design versus-maps-design section 6): what a room that picks a mode plays for, beside the default annihilation. One file per map, data/versus/modes/<map>.json. Read by @lions/data's `versusModeMissionOf`, which turns the chosen mode into the objective rows (each with a `side`) and the camps a goals-only MissionRuntime takes -- no income, production, trigger or wave, and `checkEnd` never ends it, so `outcome.ts` decides the match ('won by objective', the mode named). `camp`: destroy the enemy camp (a `raze` on the camp's footprint, no `seconds`: the match cap is its clock). `points`: a points race (a `score` objective per side, built on the zone holder rule income uses). `flag`: capture the flag, v1 a RAID (GH-976 P3): a side wins by holding a `capture` on the enemy end's flag zone, alone, for `hold_s` seconds; an enemy unit inside the zone, or nobody of the side there, resets the hold. There is no carried flag. A mode file is NOT a rules file: it carries its own camps, because a mirror room has no rules file and no economy. `pnpm validate:data` (tools/validate_versus_modes.mjs) holds the cross-file rules the schema cannot see.

id.description: The map id (one file per map).

map.description: A map in data/maps that a versus room is offered on.

camps.description: Where each END's camp stands in a room that plays the `camp` mode (the structure type `camp`, which is not authored): top-left tile and footprint, by END like the rules files. Required when `modes.camp` is present. Which SIDE stands at an end is the room's call.

flags.description: Where each END's flag zone stands in a room that plays the `flag` mode (the zones `flag_friendly` and `flag_hostile`, which the loader adds to the map's): top-left tile and footprint, by END like `camps`. Required when `modes.flag` is present. The side at an end defends its flag; the other side raids it.

flag.description: Capture the flag, v1 a raid: each side holds the other end's flag zone alone for `hold_s` seconds. Both sides play the same number.

hold_s.description: Seconds a side must hold the enemy flag zone uncontested, in one go (a contact, or leaving, restarts the count).

camp.description: Destroy the camp: each side razes the other end's camp. No parameters.

points.description: Points race: first to `target` points wins. Both sides play the same numbers.

zones.description: Zones that pay `per_min` points a minute to whichever side holds them alone (a contested or empty zone pays nobody). Each names a zone in the map's zones, or (with `at` and `size`) declares its own ground.

at.description: GH-976 P4: top-left tile of a ground this mode DECLARES (the loader adds it to the map's zones, as it does a flag's). Absent: `zone` names a zone the map already declares. A map whose own zones sit unevenly between the seats (a campaign map) gets its scoring ground from the mode file, and the campaign map is left alone.

size.description: Width and height of a declared ground, in tiles. With `at`, both or neither.

per_value_destroyed.description: Points per 100 of unit value destroyed (a unit's cost.logistics): 1 is one point for every 100 of the enemy's value that dies. 0 turns it off.
